summaryOverrides.bro: Rewrite the previous answer in plain, concise language.
summaryOverrides.code-review: Inspect an existing diff against repository standards and the originating spec.
summaryOverrides.codebase-design: Design a specific module, interface, or seam using deep-module principles.
summaryOverrides.diagnosing-bugs: Reproduce, isolate, instrument, and fix a hard bug or performance regression.
summaryOverrides.domain-modeling: Define domain terms and relationships; update the glossary and only justified ADRs.
summaryOverrides.frontend-design: Choose an intentional visual direction and build UI that avoids generic defaults.
summaryOverrides.grill-me: Start a focused grilling session to pressure-test a plan or design.
summaryOverrides.grill-with-docs: Pressure-test a plan while recording glossary terms and justified ADRs.
summaryOverrides.grilling: Run the one-question-at-a-time interview loop for a plan, decision, or idea.
summaryOverrides.handoff: Condense the current session into a document another agent can continue from.
summaryOverrides.implement: Implement work from an existing specification or ticket set.
summaryOverrides.improve-codebase-architecture: Scan for structural deepening opportunities, report them visually, then explore one.
summaryOverrides.prototype: Build disposable code or UI to answer a design question before committing.
summaryOverrides.resolving-merge-conflicts: Resolve an active Git merge or rebase conflict safely.
